**Finding submitted: deviation on § 12.4 (p0045).**

- **Issue:** § 12.4 is a one-sided *no-hire* on us — it bars soliciting, hiring or employing *any* Vendor employee for the term plus 24 months, "regardless of how the employee applies", i.e. with no general-advertising or unsolicited-applicant carve-out. That is walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT and it directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** replaced with a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, plus general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and an express no-no-hire statement — the playbook fallback, drawn from the Harbor Consulting precedent. The comment flags that deletion of § 12.4 (our preferred position) is equally acceptable.
